# SaaShup

> SaaShup turns a Docker app into a SaaS: every new customer gets their own private copy of the app, on its own address, with no extra setup for the developer. European team, hosted in Europe.

- Each customer gets their own copy (single-tenant), created automatically when they sign up.
- One release updates every customer, with undo.
- Your brand and your domain; HTTPS is set up automatically.
- Built on open-source tools: Docker, Traefik, Cloudflare, Keycloak, Prometheus, Grafana, FlowG.
